defmodule ChatServer.PaymentChannel do
  use Phoenix.Channel
  alias ChatServer.{Accounts, Billing, PubSub}

  @premium_rate 500  # cents per month
  @gift_limit 10_000  # max gift in cents

  def join("payments:" <> user_id, _params, socket) do
    if authorized?(socket, user_id) do
      {:ok, assign(socket, :user_id, user_id)}
    else
      {:error, %{reason: "unauthorized"}}
    end
  end

  def handle_in("subscribe_premium", %{"token" => token}, socket) do
    user_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    case Billing.charge(user_id, @premium_rate, token) do
      {:ok, transaction} ->
        Accounts.upgrade_to_premium(user_id)
        broadcast!(socket, "status_change", %{user_id: user_id, status: "premium"})
        {:reply, {:ok, %{transaction_id: transaction.id}}, socket}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: reason}}, socket}
    end
  end

  def handle_in("send_gift", %{"recipient_id" => recipient_id, "amount" => amount, "token" => token}, socket) do
    sender_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    with :ok <- validate_gift_amount(amount),
         :ok <- validate_recipient(sender_id, recipient_id),
         {:ok, transaction} <- process_gift_transfer(sender_id, recipient_id, amount, token, socket) do
      {:reply, {:ok, %{transaction_id: transaction.id}}, socket}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, %{reason: reason}}, socket}
    end
  end

  def handle_in("refund_gift", %{"transaction_id" => txn_id}, socket) do
    user_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    case Billing.get_transaction(txn_id) do
      {:ok, txn} when txn.sender_id == user_id ->
        process_refund(txn, socket)
      {:ok, _txn} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: "not_owner"}}, socket}
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: "transaction_not_found"}}, socket}
    end
  end

  defp process_gift_transfer(sender_id, recipient_id, amount, token, socket) do
    # Debit sender
    case Billing.charge(sender_id, amount, token) do
      {:ok, debit_txn} ->
        # Credit recipient balance
        credit_result = Billing.credit(recipient_id, compute_net_amount(amount))
        case credit_result do
          {:ok, credit_txn} ->
            txn = Billing.link_transactions(debit_txn, credit_txn, %{
              sender_id: sender_id,
              recipient_id: recipient_id,
              gross_amount: amount
            })
            notify_gift(socket, sender_id, recipient_id, amount)
            txn
          {:error, reason} ->
            # Rollback: refund the sender
            Billing.reverse(debit_txn)
            {:error, reason}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp process_refund(txn, socket) do
    elapsed_ms = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - txn.created_at_mono
    refund_window_ms = get_refund_window(txn)

    if elapsed_ms <= refund_window_ms do
      case Billing.atomic_refund_gift(txn) do
        {:ok, reversal} ->
          broadcast!(socket, "gift_refunded", %{transaction_id: txn.id})
          {:reply, {:ok, %{reversal_id: reversal.id}}, socket}
        {:error, :already_refunded} ->
          {:reply, {:error, %{reason: "already_refunded"}}, socket}
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:reply, {:error, %{reason: reason}}, socket}
      end
    else
      {:reply, {:error, %{reason: "refund_window_expired"}}, socket}
    end
  end

  defp get_refund_window(_txn) do
    # Fixed 5-minute refund window for all users
    300_000
  end

  defp compute_net_amount(gross_amount) do
    # Platform takes 5% fee
    fee_basis = 95
    trunc(gross_amount * fee_basis / 100)
  end

  defp validate_gift_amount(amount) when is_integer(amount) and amount > 0 and amount <= @gift_limit, do: :ok
  defp validate_gift_amount(_), do: {:error, "invalid_amount"}

  defp validate_recipient(sender_id, recipient_id) do
    cond do
      sender_id == recipient_id -> {:error, "cannot_gift_self"}
      not Accounts.exists?(recipient_id) -> {:error, "recipient_not_found"}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp notify_gift(socket, sender_id, recipient_id, amount) do
    PubSub.broadcast("user:#{recipient_id}", "gift_received", %{
      from: sender_id,
      amount: amount
    })
  end

  defp authorized?(socket, user_id) do
    socket.assigns[:current_user_id] == user_id
  end
end
